title: Initialize a Cargo workspace whose packages release independently
prompt: Use the monochange CLI initializer to adopt this Cargo workspace. acme-core and acme-cli must continue releasing independently. Record a patch release for an acme-cli diagnostic wording fix. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: The generated default shared group must be removed or narrowed so a CLI-only fix cannot release acme-core. Both crates remain configured and the pending preview releases only acme-cli at 1.4.1.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.
This adoption task explicitly asks to exercise the actual initializer before refining its starter configuration.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.deepEqual(c.packages.map(p=>[p.id,p.package_type]).sort(),[["acme-cli","cargo"],["acme-core","cargo"]]); assert.equal(c.cargo.enabled,true);'
checks.why: Both actual Cargo packages must be managed with their adapter enabled.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.release_targets.map(t=>[t.id,t.version]),[["acme-cli","1.4.1"]]); assert.deepEqual(d.released_packages,["acme-cli"]);'
checks.why: Independent releases are a user requirement, so the default init group must not bump the unaffected library.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; for (const p of ["core","cli"]) assert.match(fs.readFileSync(`crates/${p}/Cargo.toml`,"utf8"),/^version = "1.4.0"$/m);'
checks.why: Adoption and preview must not write package versions.
